content.text: Monitoring shows correct owners for the last three EU overnight windows.
Escalation auto-assign skipped the EU overnight on-call rotation and assigned tickets to the previous daytime owner.
Rotation schedule entries for EU overnight were present but the assigner used UTC day boundaries incorrectly when selecting the active shift.
Correct the timezone handling, add fixture coverage for overnight EU windows, and reassign any tickets misrouted during the affected nights.
